title: My cute "coworkers" run a tiny farm under my window🌱
author: DOPAMGAMES

comments.author: DOPAMGAMES
comments.body:
Hi everyone! I'm making Fluffy Coworkers, a cozy idle game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Little animals farm, cook and sell while you work or study, and you can give them a pat whenever you need a break 🐑



If it looks like your kind of cozy, here's the Steam page 💛

👉 [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5638770/Fluffy\_Coworkers/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5638770/Fluffy_Coworkers/)

replies.author: FrickinSilly
replies.body:
Very cute game. But just a note. I genuinely thought the excel window was a part of the game. Like you are managing the village with those numbers. 

Are you trying to communicate that the village carries on as you do your own work on the computer? Because I feel like that might be lost on others as well.

replies.author: DOPAMGAMES
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback! Yes, that's the exact idea. I'll definitely tweak the trailer to make it clearer.
